name: testimonial-wall
title: Testimonial Wall
description: An endless wall of reviews in columns that drift in opposite directions at slightly different speeds. Cards swell as they pass the middle and recede toward the edges, like reading through a lens. Hover a column and it eases to a stop while the others slow down; drag the wall to scrub it and let go to fling it. Cards can highlight a phrase or turn into a big-number card, and a Pause button stops everything.
